pages.title: project_output
pages.html:
Read the latest project task live display tail without waiting for execution locks. Same 256 KiB bounded journal, distinct stream IDs and conditional replacement semantics as build_output; supply both streamId/revision or neither. context identifies the task system/directory once validated; it can be empty before discovery and is absent before the first task. Cargo metadata is excluded; compiler-message rendered text is displayed and protocol artifacts are suppressed. Cargo framing caps each live protocol line at 64 KiB and reports an omission explicitly; the original process/final parser bytes stay unchanged. byteCount/droppedBytes count published display bytes, not original Cargo JSON bytes. Plain compiler/script text is merged stdout/stderr with UTF-8/control repair. Terminal applications, arbitrary plugin processes, retained history, push notifications and inferred progress are excluded. Final process outcomes/diagnostics remain on the original task result. Requires process.execute because logs may be private. Poll about 250 ms or slower.

pages.title: project_launch
pages.html:
Build/run a Cargo or Java main target, including Maven/Gradle resolved runtime classpaths, or start an npm script in a persistent PTY. Actual class-file main methods determine Java targets; Maven runtime metadata selects one module directory. No browser or Java debugger is launched.

pages.title: debug_configure
pages.html:
Update and atomically save supported debug profile fields in .cycode/launch.json, including the typed javaAttach endpoint. Optional expectedProfile must match the complete observed native profile; mismatch rejects the update without writing. Optional unrealLaunch persists the bound build/launch context; set it null to detach. Bound program/cwd/args/runtime are checked by the common Unreal owner before saving or launch. Existing disk baseline guards still apply. Arguments are literal argv. No compiler, DNS lookup, language server, network connection or debug session starts during configuration.

pages.title: debug_launch
pages.html:
Launch through the shared DAP owner. builtin.java requires enabled JDT LS with the Microsoft java-debug bundle and explicit mainClass/classPaths; it obtains the adapter port from the server and connects only to IPv4 loopback. Reconfiguration invalidates the session. Native/.NET and contributed stdio adapters retain their owners. Supplied fields override the saved profile; this operation does not build or install tools.

pages.title: debug_attach
pages.html:
Attach through the shared DAP owner. Set adapterId=builtin.java for JDWP: javaAttach supplies hostName, port and timeout (100-10000 ms), or uses the saved/default endpoint. Java rejects pid and needs enabled JDT LS plus java-debug, without build/main class/classpath requirements. Local JDT LS connects to the explicit local/remote JVM; the DAP socket stays loopback. Other adapters require a positive pid. Stop detaches and leaves existing targets running; no target terminal is started for Java attach.

pages.title: debug_continue
pages.html:
Continue the paused debuggee in the selected thread. Optional observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId guards reject changed contexts; omissions capture the current context when queued. singleThread requires supportsSingleThreadExecutionRequests. Granularity is not a Continue argument. Returns actual optional allThreadsContinued in lastExecution; acceptance is distinct from a later stop. Not cancellable after submission.

pages.title: debug_hot_reload
pages.html:
Manually compile the imported JDT workspace incrementally (java/buildWorkspace=false), then send java-debug redefineClasses on the same Java DAP session. Requires sessionGeneration from debug_status and saved/conflict-free open documents unchanged during compilation. Build errors/cancellation prevent application. Returns javaReload with actual class names or unchanged; DAP success with errorMessage is failure. JDT source/output mapping and JVM redefine support are prerequisites. Does not enable imports/autobuild or restart a JVM. Applying changes is not undoable; a failed/expired request may have partially applied changes.

pages.title: debug_cancel_reload
pages.html:
Signal cancellation before Java redefineClasses is sent. Optional operationId matches a pending reload (including a queued one); omission targets the reload in debug_status. Cancels the owned JDT build request without restarting/stopping the Java server or JVM. Does not undo changes or cancel an already submitted VM redefine request. Refresh debug_status for the final outcome.

pages.title: debug_next
pages.html:
Step over in the observed selected thread. Optional granularity (statement/line/instruction) requires supportsSteppingGranularity; omission uses the adapter default without sending that field. singleThread requires supportsSingleThreadExecutionRequests. Optional observed context rejects stale calls; omitted context is captured when queued. Actual stopped events supply the resulting stack. Not cancellable after submission.

pages.title: debug_step_back
pages.html:
Execute one backward step through a debugger advertising supportsStepBack. Requires explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId and a paused selected thread. Optional granularity/singleThread require their own capabilities. The adapter must provide reverse/recorded execution; CyCode does not synthesize target history. Acknowledgement does not prove the next stop completed. No automatic retry or cancellation after submission.

pages.text: Execute one backward step through a debugger advertising supportsStepBack. Requires explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId and a paused selected thread. Optional granularity/singleThread require their own capabilities. The adapter must provide reverse/recorded execution; CyCode does not synthesize target history. Acknowledgement does not prove the next stop completed. No automatic retry or cancellation after submission. pages.html:

Sends one restartFrame and awaits the actual stopped event; no automatic stepIn or VM restart. Re-execution can repeat program side effects and does not undo I/O. Not source Undo, cancellable after submission or automatically retried.

pages.title: debug_step_in_targets
pages.html:
Read actual step-in targets for the observed selected paused frame through supportsStepInTargetsRequest. Requires explicit sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId/frameId. Returns at most 128 host-issued handles and actual labels/ranges (one-based UTF-16 coordinates; zero means unknown). Raw signed adapter IDs stay private. Refresh replaces the sole catalogue; handles expire on resume, a new stop, invalidation, capability/frame/thread/session changes or execution submission. Empty targets is an actual adapter result. Bounds: 4 KiB request, 512 KiB reply, 4096-byte labels; no arbitrary DAP request.

Consumes the complete catalogue before submission; no raw targetId, fabricated target, automatic retry, rollback, source Undo or cancellation after submission. Inspect debug_status.lastExecution for accepted/unconfirmed acknowledgement and wait for actual stopped events. Public execution arguments retain the issued handle, never the adapter ID. pages.title: debug_run_to_cursor
pages.html:
Continue normally to a verified destination line using a session-only source breakpoint lease. Requires explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId, workspace path/one-based line, expectedDocumentId/expectedRevision from documents_read and expectedBreakpoints from debug_status.breakpoints[path] (empty if absent). Native source identity/revision/clean disk bytes are checked before arming and again before continuing; this does not prove source matches the compiled binary. Preserves all configured source breakpoints, reuses an unconditional destination breakpoint, rejects conditional/logpoint collisions and relocated/unverified/ambiguous verification. Optional singleThread needs its adapter capability; no granularity or arbitrary DAP fields. One continue acknowledgement appears in lastExecution; runToCursor reports lease/restoration and actual/unknown target hit. Restores the exact original list at the next actual stop, including earlier breakpoints/exceptions/pause. Late requests must settle before restoration; failed/uncertain cases stay leased until explicit repair or session stop. No saved breakpoint edits, cancellation after submission, automatic resume/retry or source Undo. Bounds: 1 MiB public request, 1000 total breakpoints including a new temporary point, 512 KiB reply, 256 deferred events/1 MiB/64 KiB each.

pages.text: Continue normally to a verified destination line using a session-only source breakpoint lease. Requires explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId, workspace path/one-based line, expectedDocumentId/expectedRevision from documents_read and expectedBreakpoints from debug_status.breakpoints[path] (empty if absent). Native source identity/revision/clean disk bytes are checked before arming and again before continuing; this does not prove source matches the compiled binary. Preserves all configured source breakpoints, reuses an unconditional destination breakpoint, rejects conditional/logpoint collisions and relocated/unverified/ambiguous verification. Optional singleThread needs its adapter capability; no granularity or arbitrary DAP fields. One continue acknowledgement appears in lastExecution; runToCursor reports lease/restoration and actual/unknown target hit. Restores the exact original list at the next actual stop, including earlier breakpoints/exceptions/pause. Late requests must settle before restoration; failed/uncertain cases stay leased until explicit repair or session stop. No saved breakpoint edits, cancellation after submission, automatic resume/retry or source Undo. Bounds: 1 MiB public request, 1000 total breakpoints including a new temporary point, 512 KiB reply, 256 deferred events/1 MiB/64 KiB each. pages.title: debug_restore_run_to_cursor
pages.html:
Explicitly restore the run-to-cursor lease original source breakpoint list after an uncertain failure. Requires observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration and expectedRevision from debug_status.runToCursor.revision, an actual confirmed stop and no outstanding arm/continue/restore replies. Sends one full original-list replacement and validates its response. Does not resume, edit saved breakpoints, automatically retry or cancel an in-flight request. Pause first when the stopped state is uncertain; stopping the debug session also ends the lease. Noncancellable after submission.

pages.text: Explicitly restore the run-to-cursor lease original source breakpoint list after an uncertain failure. Requires observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration and expectedRevision from debug_status.runToCursor.revision, an actual confirmed stop and no outstanding arm/continue/restore replies. Sends one full original-list replacement and validates its response. Does not resume, edit saved breakpoints, automatically retry or cancel an in-flight request. Pause first when the stopped state is uncertain; stopping the debug session also ends the lease. Noncancellable after submission. pages.title: debug_goto_target
pages.html:
Set the next statement through one DAP goto, using an issued debug_goto_targets handle and the same explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId/frameId. This skips intervening code or permits its repetition; it does NOT run to the cursor, continue the program or undo program side effects. No granularity/singleThread, raw targetId, arbitrary source/command, automatic retry or source Undo. Consumes both target catalogues before submission. Acknowledgement is recorded as accepted/unconfirmed in lastExecution using only public handles. pendingStop blocks inspection/execution until the actual relocated stopped event; a missing event after 15 seconds reports unconfirmed without automatic continuation. Not cancellable after submission.

pages.text: Set the next statement through one DAP goto, using an issued debug_goto_targets handle and the same explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration/threadId/frameId. This skips intervening code or permits its repetition; it does NOT run to the cursor, continue the program or undo program side effects. No granularity/singleThread, raw targetId, arbitrary source/command, automatic retry or source Undo. Consumes both target catalogues before submission. Acknowledgement is recorded as accepted/unconfirmed in lastExecution using only public handles. pendingStop blocks inspection/execution until the actual relocated stopped event; a missing event after 15 seconds reports unconfirmed without automatic continuation. Not cancellable after submission. pages.title: debug_set_variable
pages.html:
Assign a named child of a variablesReference through supportsSetVariable. Requires explicit observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration and a paused target. Prefer debug_set_expression when the variable has evaluateName and supportsSetExpression. value is an adapter/language expression, including an empty string. pages.title: debug_set_expression
pages.html:
Assign an expression through supportsSetExpression in the observed selected frameId. Requires explicit sessionGeneration/stopGeneration and a paused target; rejects a changed frame instead of assigning in the new context. Returns adapter value/type in lastMutation and invalidates inspection after an attempt. Expressions may execute target code; there is no automatic Undo, retry, source edit or cancellation after submission. On transport/adapter failure inspect debug_status.lastMutation before any new attempt.

pages.title: debug_write_memory
pages.html:
Write 1 to 4096 explicit bytes at an opaque memoryReference and optional offset. Requires observed sessionGeneration/stopGeneration, paused target, and supportsReadMemoryRequest plus supportsWriteMemoryRequest. expectedBytes must have the same length as bytes and match a fresh native read before submitting writeMemory with allowPartial=false. This comparison is not atomic. Re-reads afterward; lastMutation distinguishes applied/readBackVerified, partial, rejected and unconfirmed. bytesWritten is exposed only when actually reported by the adapter. Inspection expires after each attempt. Target changes have no automatic Undo, rollback, retry or cancellation once submitted.

Not undoable or cancellable once submitted to the adapter. pages.title: debug_instruction_breakpoints
pages.html:
Replace the complete session-only instruction breakpoint list (empty clears). Requires supportsInstructionBreakpoints and explicit paused sessionGeneration/stopGeneration plus expectedRevision from debug_status.instructionBreakpointRevision. Entries use adapter instruction/memory references or actual disassembly addresses, optional byte offset within 1 MiB, enabled and capability-gated condition/hitCondition. Disabled entries are retained locally with verification:null and omitted from DAP; active entries retain actual verification, optional relocated address/offset and pending/failed reason. Bounds: 128 entries / 1 MiB request, 512 KiB reply; exact duplicate reference/offset pairs are rejected natively. Events received before acknowledgement are bounded and reconciled by actual IDs. Failures/late effects leave instructionBreakpointsSynchronized=false with the last known list; inspect status then explicitly replace/clear. References are caller-reviewed for this pause, never persisted/rebased across launches. No automatic retry, Undo or cancellation after submission.

Index completeness depends on background analysis. Returns bounded normalized symbols with snapshot-local node/parent/depth, fullRange, deprecation, backend/epoch and invalid-row count. pages.title: unreal_launch_profile
pages.html:
Prepare a shared debug profile patch for an installed UE4/UE5 editor, standalone game (-game) or uncooked dedicated server (-server). Uses the current host platform and Development or DebugGame (requires the installed configuration-specific editor executable), an optional existing /Game map, typed listen/port/window/resolution/log flags and build/entry options. Listen requires an explicit map. Build-before-debug requires a discovered Editor target; disable for content-only projects. Reads files only and starts/saves nothing. Requires process.execute like debug_profile because expectedProfile includes the saved environment. Review settings and send them with returned expectedProfile to debug_configure, then use debug_run or debug_launch; those SDK calls do not build automatically. Persists unrealLaunch with the exact Unreal build profile and normalized launch options, and preserves other saved fields such as watches/environment when configuring the patch. Desktop build-before-debug uses the bound target/configuration, independent of toolbar changes; SDK calls do not compile. The preview is not an execution permit or a frozen engine/content snapshot; actual launch validates executable availability through the shared owner. No cooked-server/game binary, client connection URL, PIE, Live Coding or Blueprint debugging.

pages.text: Prepare a shared debug profile patch for an installed UE4/UE5 editor, standalone game (-game) or uncooked dedicated server (-server). Uses the current host platform and Development or DebugGame (requires the installed configuration-specific editor executable), an optional existing /Game map, typed listen/port/window/resolution/log flags and build/entry options. Listen requires an explicit map. Build-before-debug requires a discovered Editor target; disable for content-only projects. Reads files only and starts/saves nothing. Requires process.execute like debug_profile because expectedProfile includes the saved environment. Review settings and send them with returned expectedProfile to debug_configure, then use debug_run or debug_launch; those SDK calls do not build automatically. Persists unrealLaunch with the exact Unreal build profile and normalized launch options, and preserves other saved fields such as watches/environment when configuring the patch. Desktop build-before-debug uses the bound target/configuration, independent of toolbar changes; SDK calls do not compile. The preview is not an execution permit or a frozen engine/content snapshot; actual launch validates executable availability through the shared owner. No cooked-server/game binary, client connection URL, PIE, Live Coding or Blueprint debugging. pages.html:

Positions/lengths use UTF-16; glyphStart/glyphEnd are Unicode-codepoint indexes. supported=false means lexical fallback. Data is bounded to 50,000 tokens or 4 MiB and reports truncation. pages.title: build_location
pages.html:
Resolve one compiler display line to an existing workspace file without executing tools or reading file contents. Supports explicit path(line,column), path:line:column, path:line, Rust arrows and GLSL ERROR/WARNING file prefixes, plus numeric MSBuild project prefixes. pages.title: build_output
pages.html:
Read the latest explicit native build output tail without waiting for adapter/plugin/document locks. Retains at most 256 KiB of raw merged stdout/stderr in memory until the next build or workspace close. CMake configure/build/preset execution, MSBuild build/rebuild/clean/restore and explicit Unreal UBT/UAT execution opt in; tool discovery, structured evaluation, background analysis, project tasks and trusted plugin-owned processes are excluded. Initial requests use {}; conditional requests supply both streamId and revision. changed:true replaces the entire prior display tail; changed:false has empty output. A new streamId distinguishes builds even when operationId is reused. byteCount/droppedBytes count original bytes, not returned Unicode characters; text repairs invalid UTF-8, NUL/control bytes and may replace a split character at either retained edge. No ANSI/terminal interpretation, code-page detection, history archive, progress percentage, implicit artifact or SDK/MCP push notification. incomplete reports a journal failure; lifecycle/final exit remain available through the original build response. process.execute is required because compiler output can contain private project data. Poll at about 250 ms or slower; no cancellation or mutation of the running build.

"""CyCode operations. Generated manifest is the public CyTools v1 contract."""
from pathlib import Path
import json

def schema(properties=None, required=()):
    return {'type': 'object', 'properties': properties or {}, 'required': list(required), 'additionalProperties': False}

PATH = {'type': 'string', 'minLength': 1, 'description': 'Workspace reference; live document operations also accept issued untitled references. Not a temporary input artifact. Filesystem operations require actual workspace paths.'}

BOOL = {'type': 'boolean'}
ARRAY = {'type': 'array', 'items': {'type': 'object'}}
DOCUMENT = schema({'path': STRING, 'text': STRING, 'revision': REVISION, 'dirty': BOOL,
                   'id': {'type':'integer','minimum':0},
                   'diskConflict': STRING,
                   'untitled': BOOL, 'displayPath': STRING,
                   'lineEnding': STRING, 'encoding': STRING}, ('path', 'text', 'revision', 'dirty', 'lineEnding', 'encoding'))
RECOVERY_REF = {'session':STRING,'id':STRING,'checkpoint':STRING}
NONNEGATIVE = {'type':'integer','minimum':0}
BUILD_OUTPUT_FIELDS = {'running':BOOL,'cancelling':BOOL,'operationId':{'type':'string','maxLength':128},
    'method':{'type':'string','maxLength':128},'streamId':{'type':'string','maxLength':128},'revision':NONNEGATIVE,
    'changed':BOOL,'byteCount':NONNEGATIVE,'droppedBytes':NONNEGATIVE,'incomplete':BOOL,
    'encoding':{'const':'utf8-repaired'},'output':{'type':'string','maxLength':786432}}
BUILD_OUTPUT = schema(BUILD_OUTPUT_FIELDS,tuple(BUILD_OUTPUT_FIELDS))
BUILD_OUTPUT['allOf']=[{'if':{'properties':{'changed':{'const':False}}},'then':{'properties':{'output':{'const':''}}}},
    {'if':{'properties':{'cancelling':{'const':True}}},'then':{'properties':{'running':{'const':True}}}}]
BUILD_OUTPUT_INPUT = schema({'streamId':{'type':'string','minLength':1,'maxLength':128,'pattern':'^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$','not':{'pattern':'[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]'}},'revision':NONNEGATIVE})
BUILD_OUTPUT_INPUT['dependentRequired']={'streamId':['revision'],'revision':['streamId']}
PROJECT_OUTPUT = schema({**BUILD_OUTPUT_FIELDS,'context':schema({'system':STRING,'directory':STRING},('system','directory'))},tuple(BUILD_OUTPUT_FIELDS))
PROJECT_OUTPUT['allOf']=BUILD_OUTPUT['allOf']
COMPILER_LOCATION_INPUT = schema({'text':{'type':'string','maxLength':16384,
    'not':{'pattern':r'[\u0000-\u0008\u000A-\u000C\u000E-\u001F\u007F]'}},
    'directory':{'type':'string','minLength':1,'maxLength':8192}},('text',))

    'line':{'type':'integer','minimum':1,'maximum':10000000},

COMPILER_LOCATION['allOf']=[{'if':{'properties':{'mapped':{'const':True}}},
    'then':{'required':['path','line','column','format'],'properties':{'reason':{'const':''}}},
    'else':{'not':{'anyOf':[{'required':[key]} for key in ('path','line','column','format')]}}}]

    ('session','documents','bytes','lastCheckpoint','maxDocuments','maxBytes','pending','errors','intervalMs'))

def write_manifest():
    path = Path(__file__).with_name('CyTool.json')
    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text('utf-8'))
    manifest.update(description='Native C++ IDE services, shared by CyUI and CyToolsCore MCP.', version='0.2.0',
                    executable='python app/tool.py', standaloneExecutable='CyCode.exe', categories=['development'], tags=['IDE', 'C++', 'plugins'],

                    concurrency={'policy': 'Concurrent', 'maxWorkers': 4}, distributionStatus='Development milestone; see app/Docs/Validation.md')
    for platform in manifest['platforms']:
        platform['status'] = 'Experimental'
    manifest['operations'] = [dict(id=op, name=op.replace('_', ' ').title(),
        description=description+(' This typed operation always targets built-in Git in the selected workspace repository; use vcs_provider_action for plugins.' if method in GIT_METHODS else ''),

        **({'exclusiveGroups':['plugin-packages']} if method.startswith('packages.') and method not in ('packages.list','packages.inspect') else
           {'exclusiveGroups': ['workspace-mutations']} if permissions and method not in ('terminal.list','terminal.read','debug.status','debug.profile','unreal.launchProfile','debug.cancelReload','project.cancel','project.output','tests.cancel','build.cancel','build.output','packages.list','packages.inspect') else {}))
        for op, method, description, inputs, outputs, permissions in OPERATIONS]
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    write_manifest()

def write_manifest():

    manifest = json.loads(path.read_text('utf-8'))
    manifest.update(description='Native C++ IDE services, shared by CyUI and CyToolsCore MCP.', version='0.2.0',
                    executable='python app/tool.py', standaloneExecutable='CyCode.exe', categories=['development'], tags=['IDE', 'C++', 'plugins'],
                    capabilities=['jobs', 'cancellation', 'live-documents', 'text-search', 'cpp-navigation', 'cpp-symbols', 'cpp-refactoring', 'csharp-language', 'multilingual-lsp', 'project-tasks', 'readonly-sdk-sources', 'terminal', 'dap-debugger', 'git', 'native-plugins', 'msbuild'],
                    concurrency={'policy': 'Concurrent', 'maxWorkers': 4}, distributionStatus='Development milestone; see app/Docs/Validation.md')
    for platform in manifest['platforms']:

    manifest['operations'] = [dict(id=op, name=op.replace('_', ' ').title(),
        description=description+(' This typed operation always targets built-in Git in the selected workspace repository; use vcs_provider_action for plugins.' if method in GIT_METHODS else ''),

        supportedBackends=[], permissions=permissions, canRunAsync=True, canCancel=not (method.startswith('packages.') or method.startswith('vcs.replay.') or method.startswith('vcs.merge.') or method.startswith('vcs.checkout.') or method.startswith('vcs.conflict.') or method.startswith('vcs.worktree.') or method.startswith('vcs.submodule') or method in DEBUG_MUTATIONS or method in DEBUG_EXECUTIONS or method in ('documents.createUntitled','documents.saveAs','documents.close','debug.dataBreakpoints','debug.runToCursor','debug.restoreRunToCursor','debug.instructionBreakpoints')), supportsProgress=False,
        **({'exclusiveGroups':['plugin-packages']} if method.startswith('packages.') and method not in ('packages.list','packages.inspect') else
           {'exclusiveGroups': ['workspace-mutations']} if permissions and method not in ('terminal.list','terminal.read','debug.status','debug.profile','unreal.launchProfile','debug.cancelReload','project.cancel','project.output','tests.cancel','build.cancel','build.output','packages.list','packages.inspect') else {}))
        for op, method, description, inputs, outputs, permissions in OPERATIONS]
    path.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    write_manifest()

}); self.output = client.run(request.at("action"), request.at("parameters")) .dump(-1, ' ', false, Json::error_handler_t::replace); if (self.output.size() > 4 * 1024 * 1024) throw std::runtime_error("Diversion response exceeds 4 MiB"); } catch (const std::exception &e) { self.output = Json({{"error", e.what()}}).dump(-1, ' ', false, Json::error_handler_t::replace); } catch (...) { self.output = "{\"error\":\"Diversion extension failed\"}"; } return self.output.c_str(); } } // namespace extern "C" CYCODE_PLUGIN_EXPORT int cycode_plugin_init_v2(const CyCodeHostV2 *host, void **instance) noexcept { if (!host || !instance || host->abi_version != CYCODE_PLUGIN_ABI_V2 || host->struct_size < offsetof(CyCodeHostV2, features) || !host->contribute) return 1; *instance = nullptr; try { auto self = std::make_unique<Instance>(); if (host->contribute(host->context, "vcs", cycode::diversion::descriptor().dump().c_str(), dispatch)) return 1; *instance = self.release(); return 0; } catch (...) { return 1; } } extern "C" CYCODE_PLUGIN_EXPORT void cycode_plugin_shutdown_v2(void *instance) noexcept { delete static_cast<Instance *>(instance); }
